_about: The owner's standing decisions on sales records, applied to public/data/sf-listings.geojson by scripts/apply-sale-decisions.mjs on every data refresh (geocode-listings.mjs runs it after validation). Records left out are listed in data/removed-sales.csv, corrected records in data/edited-sales.csv, and reports/market/review.py shows both every month. The reporting period end is data/reporting-period.json.

minPrice.reason: Under $100K: parking, a rental or an entry error, not a home sale (owner, Oct 16 2026).

duplicates.reason: The same sale entered twice; counted once, keeping the Closed record (owner, Oct 16 2026).

keep.note: A quick flip: two real sales, both count (owner, Oct 16 2026).

pointOut.note: Over $25M is probably an entry error: kept, but always pointed out in the monthly review (owner, Oct 16 2026).

edits.reason: Square footage from the duplicate entry of the same sale (MLS 425037665, 4035 25th St), which reported 1,195 sf (owner, Oct 16 2026).
